columns.label: Date
columns.formula: Publication date on the source file.

columns.label: CL managed net
columns.formula: Managed money long minus short. Spreads are not included.

columns.label: CL net / OI
columns.formula: Managed money net divided by open interest. z uses the train mean and train population standard deviation of this ratio.

columns.label: COT z
columns.formula: Managed-money net divided by open interest on CFTC 067651. Z-score uses the train mean and the train population standard deviation of that ratio. Train mean 0.1146. Train standard deviation 0.0386. The percentile is the share of train ratios at or below the current print. Spreads are not inside the net.

columns.label: COT percentile
columns.formula: Share of train mm_net_oi prints at or below the current print, times 100. The train distribution is frozen.

columns.label: Brent managed net
columns.formula: CFTC 06765T managed money long minus short.

columns.label: Brent net / OI
columns.formula: CFTC 06765T managed money net divided by open interest.
